//: This file pins the SDK band for everything in the repository, and deliberately carries no workloadVersion: a workload pin applies to every project below the file holding it, and with one here an ordinary test project could not build unless the MAUI workload set resolved too. That pin lives in GospelPresenter/global.json instead. rollForward is latestPatch, and this is the file setup-dotnet reads, so it decides which patch CI actually installs -- the newest in the band, 10.0.204 on the runners as of 2026-08-31. The nested file has to stay latestPatch for the same reason: its workloadVersion is matched against whatever SDK that resolution lands on, and pinning either file to a single patch breaks the pair. Both were briefly claimed by their own comments to say disable; setting it there failed every platform job. Note that the two server Dockerfiles pin their build image to the version below, because a container reads this file too and mcr's floating sdk:10.0 tag has already moved past this band -- raise them together.
